evals.prompt: implementer: write the technical design for feature order-export. .willgt/skills.yaml has approval: decisions-file. The PRD is not on the base branch and DECISIONS.md has no approval naming it.
evals.expected_output: Checks the PRD gate. Refuses with 'no technical design from a draft PRD'. Names missing base-branch PRD and/or decisions-file approval.
assertions: Uses stop phrase no technical design from a draft PRD
Does NOT create TRD.md, openapi.yaml or event.schema.json
Names missing approval from config (decisions-file / base branch)
Does NOT require an epic tool

evals.prompt: Approved PRD for order-export needs a Redis-backed job queue. new_technology: ask-human.
evals.expected_output: Stops and asks the human with options. Decision record proposed, new_technology yes, deciders human. No dependency added.
assertions: Does NOT add a dependency to build/compose
Asks the human with at least two options
Decision record status proposed, new_technology yes
Does NOT assume the queue is approved in the TRD

evals.prompt: Approved PRD exposes GET /invoices/{id}/pdf and emits no event. design_depth: standard.
evals.expected_output: TRD with Interfaces, Data, Failure; one openapi path; no event.schema.json.
assertions: Reads TYPES.md or skill file rules

evals.prompt: Approved feature; reuse scan finds only an AGPL library for a needed capability.
evals.expected_output: Flags AGPL; does not adopt without human ruling; prefer other options or ask human.
assertions: Does not install without human ruling

evals.prompt: Approved feature refund-request; no change-impact record yet.
evals.expected_output: Runs change-impact before writing TRD; waits for Product on new candidates.
assertions: Does not confirm candidates without Product
